description: This file contains functions for creating tar archive members and trailer, including custom header construction and padding mechanisms. It is used in the context of packaging files in an OpenWRT environment, specifically for adding files into tar archives with detailed control over metadata.

methods.name: tar_print_member
methods.description: Constructs and outputs a tar archive header for a given file name and content, including padding and checksum calculations.

methods.name: tar_print_trailer
methods.description: Outputs padding to signify the end of a tar archive.
